en.headline: Four more men charged with murder over Tsim Sha Tsui bar killing
en.dek: Four men aged 26 to 33 appeared in Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday and were remanded in custody until 29 October pending further investigation.
body: Four men were charged with murder in connection with the fatal assault of a 32-year-old businessman at a Tsim Sha Tsui bar last month and appeared in Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday.

Lai Wing-lam, 29, Leung Chun-kit, 26, Li Man-tai, 33, and Yung Wai-kin, 31, all reported to be unemployed, face one count each of murder. They were remanded in custody with no bail application until 29 October for further police inquiries. The case is linked to the death of Yang Kam-chuen after an attack at Club Revel on Cameron Road on 25 July.
Police have now arrested multiple people in the case, including a suspected triad leader earlier charged with murder. Investigations continue.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧命案再多4人被控謀殺 還押至10月
zh.dek: 4名介乎26至33歲男子周四在九龍城裁判法院提堂，被控謀殺罪，暫不准保釋，還押至10月29日再訊。
body: 尖沙咀金馬倫道樓上酒吧上月命案，警方再拘捕4名男子並控以謀殺罪。4人周四在九龍城裁判法院首次提堂。
被告分別為29歲賴永霖、26歲梁俊傑、33歲李汶泰及31歲翁偉健，均報稱無業，各被控一項謀殺罪，指他們於7月25日在金壘商業中心4樓Club Revel與其他人士一同謀殺楊淦全。4人沒有申請保釋，還押至10月29日再訊，以待警方進一步調查。
警方就案件已拘捕多人，包括早前被控謀殺的懷疑三合會頭目。調查仍在進行。
